EntityPlayerSP.overview: Client-side local player (extends AbstractClientPlayer). Predicts movement, health, input each tick. Tick flow: onUpdate (riding vs walk) -> onUpdateWalkingPlayer + onLivingUpdate (sprint, fly, portal). Bridges Minecraft, MovementInput and NetHandlerPlayClient sendQueue for all C packets.

methods.detail: Checks isBlockLoaded at player XZ. If riding sends C05 look + C0C input each tick. Else calls onUpdateWalkingPlayer. Calls super.onUpdate for entity physics first.
methods.name: onUpdate
methods.purpose: Per-tick client update; delegates to walk or riding branch.

methods.detail: Compares isSprinting/isSneaking to serverSprint/SneakState, sends C0B on change. Computes dPos>9.0E-4 or ticks>=20 (flag2) and yaw/pitch delta (flag3) to pick C06/C04/C05/base C03.
methods.name: onUpdateWalkingPlayer
methods.purpose: Sends sprint/sneak deltas and throttled position/look updates.

methods.detail: Decrements sprintingTicksLeft/sprintToggleTimer/timeUntilPortal. Manages double-tap-W sprint, flyToggleTimer double-space + sendPlayerAbilities, horseJumpPowerCounter charging with sendHorseJump.
methods.name: onLivingUpdate
methods.purpose: Handles sprint timers, fly toggle, horse jump, portal, push-out.

methods.detail: No filtering; wraps string in C01PacketChatMessage and queues on sendQueue. Server NetHandlerPlayServer handles commands vs broadcast.
methods.name: sendChatMessage
methods.purpose: Forwards user chat to server.

methods.detail: Calls super.swingItem for client render, then sends empty C0APacketAnimation. Used for attacks, block hits, item use visuals.
methods.name: swingItem
methods.purpose: Local arm swing plus server animation notify.

methods.detail: Maps dropAll bool to DROP_ALL_ITEMS vs DROP_ITEM action with BlockPos.ORIGIN/DOWN. Returns null; server spawns EntityItem.
methods.name: dropOneItem
methods.purpose: Requests server item drop; no client spawn.

methods.detail: Sends C0DPacketCloseWindow with openContainer.windowId, then clears cursor stack and displays null screen via closeScreenAndDropStack.
methods.name: closeScreen
methods.purpose: Notifies server container close.

methods.detail: Wraps this.capabilities in C13PacketPlayerAbilities. Called on fly toggle, landing, spectator transitions in onLivingUpdate.
methods.name: sendPlayerAbilities
methods.purpose: Syncs capabilities (fly, creative) to server.

methods.detail: Sends C16 with PERFORM_RESPAWN state. Server respawns via configuration manager and resets health/location.
methods.name: respawnPlayer
methods.purpose: Requests respawn after death screen.

packet_usage.trigger: Forced keep-alive every tick when pos/look unchanged; also riding look.
Riding input each tick in onUpdate.

internal_fields.name: sendQueue
internal_fields.role: NetHandlerPlayClient used for all addToSendQueue C packets

internal_fields.name: lastReportedPosX/Y/Z + Yaw/Pitch
internal_fields.role: Last sent transform; delta vs 9.0E-4 threshold picks packet type

internal_fields.name: positionUpdateTicks
internal_fields.role: Forces C03 at least every 20 ticks when idle

internal_fields.name: serverSprintState/serverSneakState
internal_fields.role: Caches last C0B state to send only on change

internal_fields.name: movementInput
internal_fields.role: Keyboard input driving moveStrafe/Forward/jump/sneak

internal_fields.name: sprintToggleTimer/sprintingTicksLeft
internal_fields.role: Double-tap sprint window and sprint expiry timer

EntityPlayerMP.overview: Server-side player entity (extends EntityPlayer, implements ICrafting). Authoritative inventory, health, chunks, effects. Tick flow: onUpdate (block removal, container sync, destroy cache S13, chunk queue S21/S26) + onUpdateEntity (maps, S06 health, S1F XP). Owned by NetHandlerPlayServer + ItemInWorldManager.

methods.detail: Calls theItemInWorldManager.updateBlockRemoving, openContainer.detectAndSendChanges. Drains destroyedItemsNetCache into S13 batches. Streams up to 10 chunks as S21 single or S26 bulk plus tile updates.
methods.name: onUpdate
methods.purpose: Server tick: block mining, containers, chunk streaming, spectate follow.

methods.detail: Sends map packets for held maps. If health/food/saturation-vs-wasHungry changed sends S06. If experienceTotal != lastExperience sends S1F. Every 100 ticks checks exploreAllBiomes.
methods.name: onUpdateEntity
methods.purpose: Syncs maps, health/food, scoreboard, XP, biome achievement.

methods.detail: Closes prior container, checks ILockableContainer lock/canOpen/isSpectator; denies with S02 msg + S29 door sound. Else getNextWindowId and S2D with size.
methods.name: displayGUIChest
methods.purpose: Opens chest/locked container with validation.

methods.detail: Creates ContainerMerchant, assigns windowId, sends S2D minecraft:villager then MC|TrList S3F custom payload with windowId + MerchantRecipeList buffer.
methods.name: displayVillagerTradeGui
methods.purpose: Opens merchant plus recipe list.

methods.detail: Sends S2EPacketCloseWindow with openContainer.windowId then closeContainer resets to inventoryContainer. Called when canInteractWith fails.
methods.name: closeScreen
methods.purpose: Server-initiated container close.

methods.detail: Guards playerNetServerHandler null, sends S39 with capabilities then updatePotionMetadata. Called by setGameType and spectator changes.
methods.name: sendPlayerAbilities
methods.purpose: Pushes capabilities to client.

methods.detail: Sets ItemInWorldManager type, sends S2B reason 3 with type ID. Dismounts if spectator else setSpectatingEntity(self), then abilities + markPotionsDirty.
methods.name: setGameType
methods.purpose: Changes gamemode and reconciles spectator state.

methods.detail: trySleep sends S0A to trackers + self and setPlayerLocation. wakeUp broadcasts S0B anim 2. mountEntity sends S1B attach 0 then setPlayerLocation.
methods.name: trySleep/wakeUpPlayer/mountEntity
methods.purpose: Broadcasts bed, wake, ride state and resyncs position.

methods.detail: Sends S1D EntityEffect with entityId+effect on add/change, S1E RemoveEntityEffect on finish. Ensures client particles/modifiers match.
methods.name: onNewPotionEffect/onFinishedPotionEffect
methods.purpose: Syncs effect add/change/remove to client.

packet_usage.trigger: Batched destroy cache flush in onUpdate; removeEntity for non-players.

internal_fields.name: playerNetServerHandler
internal_fields.role: NetHandlerPlayServer sink for all sendPacket S messages

internal_fields.name: theItemInWorldManager
internal_fields.role: Gamemode/mining logic; back-pointer thisPlayerMP

internal_fields.name: lastHealth/lastFoodLevel/wasHungry
internal_fields.role: Dirty check to throttle S06 health sends

internal_fields.name: lastExperience/combinedHealth
internal_fields.role: Dirty checks for S1F XP and health scoreboard

internal_fields.name: loadedChunks/destroyedItemsNetCache
internal_fields.role: Queues for S21/S26 chunk send and batched S13 destroys

internal_fields.name: currentWindowId/spectatingEntity
internal_fields.role: Window counter (%100+1) for S2D and camera target for S43

EntityTrackerEntry.overview: Server per-entity tracker state machine. Decides spawn, delta move/look, velocity, metadata for each tick. Tick flow: updatePlayerList (range/ride/ItemFrame) -> motion branch (rel vs teleport) + head/velocity/metadata. Pushes via EntityPlayerMP.playerNetServerHandler to trackingPlayers set.

methods.detail: Refreshes player set if moved >16 blocks. Sends S1B on ride change. Every 10 ticks syncs ItemFrame maps+metadata. On frequency/airborne/dataChanged sends rel/teleport, velocity, metadata, head look.
methods.name: updatePlayerList
methods.purpose: Per-tick sync: range scan, attach, ItemFrame maps, movement branch.

methods.detail: Range+chunk+isSpectatedByPlayer gate. On add sends createSpawnPacket then metadata, NBT S49, attributes S20, velocity S12, attach S1B, equipment S04, bed S0A, effects S1D.
methods.name: updatePlayerEntity
methods.purpose: Adds/removes one player from tracking set with full spawn burst.

methods.detail: Switches Item/Player/Minecart/Boat/IAnimals/mobs, projectiles by type IDs (60 arrow,73 potion,etc), FallingBlock state ID, Painting/ItemFrame/LeashKnot with pos overrides.
methods.name: createSpawnPacket
methods.purpose: Factory mapping entity class to spawn packet type.

methods.detail: If hasObjectChanged sends S1C metadata. If EntityLivingBase with non-empty attribute set sends S20 properties then clears set to avoid resend.
methods.name: sendMetadataToAllAssociatedPlayers
methods.purpose: Pushes DataWatcher and attribute deltas.

methods.detail: sendPacket loops trackingPlayers sendPacket. func_151261_b also echoes to tracked EntityPlayerMP self, used for metadata/attributes/velocityChanged.
methods.name: sendPacketToTrackedPlayers/func_151261_b
methods.purpose: Fan-out helpers with self-include variant.

methods.detail: Removes from trackingPlayers set and calls player.removeEntity which queues S13 destroy or immediate send for players.
methods.name: removeFromTrackedPlayers/removeTrackedPlayerSymmetric
methods.purpose: Stops tracking and destroys entity client-side.

methods.detail: Compares player XZ to encodedPos/32 within trackingDistanceThreshold and isSpectatedByPlayer. Prevents sending hidden/spectator-blocked entities.
methods.name: func_180233_c
methods.purpose: Range + spectator visibility gate.

packet_usage.trigger: Small delta move/look within +-128 and 400-tick window.
Large delta, 400-tick force sync, or ground change.

internal_fields.name: trackedEntity/trackingPlayers
internal_fields.role: Watched entity and subscribed EntityPlayerMP set

internal_fields.name: encodedPosX/Y/Z + RotationYaw/Pitch
internal_fields.role: Last sent fixed-point pos (*32) and angle (*256/360) for delta

internal_fields.name: updateFrequency/trackingDistanceThreshold
internal_fields.role: Per-type tick divisor and XZ range gate

internal_fields.name: ticksSinceLastForcedTeleport
internal_fields.role: Forces S18 every 400 ticks to fix drift

internal_fields.name: lastTrackedEntityMotionX/Y/motionZ
internal_fields.role: Last sent velocity; 0.02 threshold for S12

internal_fields.name: updateCounter/firstUpdateDone
internal_fields.role: Tick count and initial scan flag with 16-block moved check

PlayerControllerMP.overview: Client interaction controller translating clicks/keys to server C packets with prediction. No tick entity itself; driven by Minecraft loop via updateController. Validates creative/adventure/spectator/border locally, plays sounds/particles, then sends authoritative request. Paired with NetHandlerPlayClient and EntityPlayerSP.

methods.detail: Rejects spectator/no-edit adventure and outside border. Creative sends START_DESTROY + clickBlockCreative + delay 5. Survival aborts prior block, sends START, inits curBlockDamageMP/step counter.
methods.name: clickBlock
methods.purpose: Starts block hit; creative instant vs survival progress init.

methods.detail: Honors blockHitDelay. Creative re-sends START. Survival adds getPlayerRelativeBlockHardness, step sound every 4 ticks, on >=1 sends STOP_DESTROY + onPlayerDestroyBlock + delay 5.
methods.name: onPlayerDamageBlock
methods.purpose: Accumulates crack progress and finishes block.

methods.detail: Border + spectator checks. Tries onBlockActivated, validates canPlaceBlockOnSide for ItemBlock, always sends C08 placement, then locally applies onItemUse (creative restores damage/count).
methods.name: onPlayerRightClick
methods.purpose: Block activate or ItemBlock place with prediction.

methods.detail: Blocks spectator, syncs hotbar, sends C08 with current item (pos -1), calls useItemRightClick locally and updates mainInventory if count changed.
methods.name: sendUseItem
methods.purpose: Air right-click (food, bow, etc).

methods.detail: Syncs item, sends C02 ATTACK or INTERACT (+hitVec variant). Applies local attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem/interact only if not spectator.
methods.name: attackEntity/interactWithEntitySendPacket
methods.purpose: Left-click attack vs right-click interact.

methods.detail: Gets next transaction ID, applies local slotClick, sends C0E with result + txn. Enchant sends C11 windowID+button for server-side level roll.
methods.name: windowClick/sendEnchantPacket
methods.purpose: Container click and enchant button.

methods.detail: Compares inventory.currentItem to cached currentPlayerItem; on change updates cache and sends C09 HeldItemChange.
methods.name: syncCurrentPlayItem
methods.purpose: Hotbar change notifier called before most actions.

methods.detail: reset sends ABORT_DESTROY + clears isHittingBlock/damage/progress. stopUsing sends RELEASE_USE_ITEM with ORIGIN/DOWN then local stopUsingItem.
methods.name: resetBlockRemoving/onStoppedUsingItem
methods.purpose: Abort mining and stop use.

packet_usage.trigger: Start/stop/abort mining, drop handled by SP.

internal_fields.name: netClientHandler
internal_fields.role: NetHandlerPlayClient queue for all C packets

internal_fields.name: currentBlock/isHittingBlock
internal_fields.role: Mining target and active flag; abort on change

internal_fields.name: curBlockDamageMP/stepSoundTickCounter
internal_fields.role: Accumulated hardness 0-1 and step-sound cadence

internal_fields.name: blockHitDelay
internal_fields.role: 5-tick cooldown after place/destroy

internal_fields.name: currentGameType/currentPlayerItem
internal_fields.role: Survival/creative/spectator rules and cached hotbar for C09

internal_fields.name: currentItemHittingBlock
internal_fields.role: Item used at hit start; abort if swapped via isHittingPosition
